create_data_task_config: create a DataTaskCfg dataclass instance to configure a data task pipeline with processing functions
configure_decode_function: set the decode_fn attribute on DataTaskCfg to specify how raw data samples should be decoded
configure_image_processing: set the image_process_fn attribute on DataTaskCfg to define image preprocessing for the pipeline
configure_text_processing: set the text_process_fn attribute on DataTaskCfg to define text preprocessing for the pipeline
configure_error_handling: set the error_handler attribute on DataTaskCfg to choose between ignore_and_continue or reraise_exception
